    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Windows下安装 Ollama + OpenClaw + 飞书，实现真正本地部署！</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        大家好，我是编程乐趣。OpenClaw实在太好用了，随着 Ollama 对其支持的加入，本地大模型部署迎来了全新体验。

下面我们一起通过Ollama + OpenClaw 实现真正本地部署，使用Ollama 让我们在断网的情况也可以使用，同时可以随意切换大模型，包括目前主流的Qwen 3、GLM、Kimi 等模型。

![图片](https://mmbiz.qpic.cn/mmbiz_png/i...
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>大家好，我是编程乐趣。</p>
<p>OpenClaw实在太好用了，随着 Ollama 对其支持的加入，本地大模型部署迎来了全新体验。</p>
<p>下面我们一起通过Ollama + OpenClaw 实现真正本地部署，使用Ollama 让我们在断网的情况也可以使用，同时可以随意切换大模型，包括目前主流的Qwen 3、GLM、Kimi 等模型。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217045-726749450.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="一环境要求">一、环境要求</h2>
<p>安装nodejs</p>
<p><a href="https://nodejs.org/en/download" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://nodejs.org/en/download</a></p>
<p>下载lts，大于22版本。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217042-1220082355.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="二安装最新版-ollama-客户端">二、安装最新版 Ollama 客户端</h2>
<p>在https://ollama.com/download，下载安装包或通过执行命令安装。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217054-872829944.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">Ollama安装完成后，大家可以根据自己电脑配置选择模型。官方也推荐一些模型，如果电脑配置比较低的，可以选择较低版本，只是用来学习和了解OpenClaw还是可以，工作的话还是选择高版本，模型不同效果差异还是有的。<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217077-148438517.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">OpenClaw 在执行过程中，是需要大的上下文的，建议使用支持 64k 个 token 上下文长度的模型，比如：Kimi、GLM。</p>
<p>模型安装命令如下：</p>
<p><code>ollama run glm-4.7-flash</code><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217145-1582684054.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="三安装openclaw">三、安装OpenClaw</h2>
<p>1、使用Windows 版安装命令：</p>
<p><code>iwr -useb https://openclaw.ai/install.ps1 | iex</code><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217085-914750414.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">安装成功如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217086-1033298175.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">如果出现code 128 异常情况，更换好一点的网络看看。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217295-222637173.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">或者配置 git 将 ssh 协议替换为 https</p>
<p><code>git config --global url."https://".insteadOf ssh://</code>2、安装完成后，可以使用Ollama启动OpenClaw</p>
<p><code>ollama launch openclaw</code>执行命令后，可以通过↑↓按钮，来选择需要安装的模型、或者选择已经安装好的模型。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217074-5797221.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="四对接飞书">四、对接飞书</h2>
<p><strong>安装飞书插件</strong></p>
<p><code>openclaw plugins install @m1heng-clawd/feishu</code><br>
<strong>1、创建应用</strong></p>
<p>打开 <a href="https://open.feishu.cn/app%E3%80%82%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E5%BA%94%E7%94%A8" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://open.feishu.cn/app。创建应用</a></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217126-2114652.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">填写应用名称、说明。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217096-1813646547.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>2、添加机器人</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217137-1313085688.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>3、为机器人开通权限。</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217125-1309202477.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">搜索 contact:user.base 获取用户基本信息</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217157-1862217849.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">搜索 im:message 消息权限，这边默认全部勾选。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217069-2022515386.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>4、发布应用</strong></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217139-873743534.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>5、更新飞书凭证</strong></p>
<p>首先获取应用凭证。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217105-1859575100.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">通过以下命令更新：</p>
<p><code>openclaw config set channels.feishu.appId "App Id"</code></p>
<p><code>openclaw config set channels.feishu.appSecret "App Secret"</code></p>
<p><code>openclaw config set channels.feishu.enabled true</code></p>
<p><code>openclaw config set channels.feishu.connectionMode websocket</code></p>
<p><code>openclaw config set channels.feishu.dmPolicy pairing</code></p>
<p><code>openclaw config set channels.feishu.groupPolicy allowlist</code></p>
<p><code>openclaw config set channels.feishu.requireMention true</code></p>
<p>更新如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217138-1833916117.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>6、重新启动OpenClaw</strong></p>
<p><code>openclaw gateway restart</code>在浏览器打开 <a href="http://localhost:18789/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">http://localhost:18789/</a></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217061-961142299.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>7、飞书事件配置</strong></p>
<p>事件配置：订阅方式设置为：长链接。必须先启动OpenClaw才能配置。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217116-1381207554.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">回调配置：订阅方式设置为：长链接。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217125-1681607074.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>8、配置事件</strong></p>
<p>搜索：im.message.receive，勾选接收消息事件。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217076-904815760.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>9、发布新版本</strong></p>
<p>每一次对飞书应用更改配置，我们都需要重新发布，才能生效。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217119-147131127.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>10、第一次使用</strong></p>
<p>第一次使用，OpenClaw会发生一个编码，让我们确认配对。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217075-136855867.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">配置配对编码</p>
<ul>
<li></li>
</ul>
<p><code>openclaw pairing approve feishu 这里填写你的配对码</code><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217169-1618693130.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>11、开始使用</strong></p>
<p>开始OpenClaw之旅吧！</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/93789/202603/93789-20260305102217056-1723289807.webp" alt="图片" loading="lazy">- End -</p>
